machine.note: author workstation; CI runs Ubuntu. No container engine, Python runtime or CI runner is used by this lab.

model.basis: Minutes for a learner who has read that day's topic pages. Reading uses the frozen page-estimator rate of 200 words per minute for the README, the brief and the required Jenkins reading. Each worksheet choice is charged 0.25 minute (the evidence is already read; the learner matches it to a listed option) and each why sentence 1.0 minute. Editing time is judged from the edit distance between each draft and the private solutions.

phases.derivation: uncomment, then about 8 changed lines across two services, the healthcheck and the volumes key

requiredCoreBounds.S38: about 37 minutes inside S38's 85-minute guided-lab block
requiredCoreBounds.S39: about 19 minutes, including the 4-minute Jenkins reading, inside S39's 85-minute guided-lab block, which also holds the module check
requiredCoreBounds.outsideCore: the one-time setup (about 3 minutes) is outside the required core

model.wrongFirstRetry: a failing test costs about 1 minute to read the message, make the one named repair and rerun
model.worstRequiredBasis: a planning allowance, not a measured or derived worst case: typical 56 plus a stated allowance of 4 extra failed runs at about 1 minute each = 60, the bound the README names as the pause-and-self-study point
model.fit: Each day's share occupies that day's existing frozen-calendar Lab-template guided-lab block (85 minutes) and adds no required time elsewhere.

learnerCommands.note: node --test --test-reporter=tap finishes in well under a second on the starter and on both private solutions

observed.independentAgentSolve: an independent non-author agent solved the git-archived lab from the README, the topic pages and the failure messages in 3 test runs (0/26, then 15/26 at the S38 checkpoint, then 26/26) without opening the tests, and estimated about 44 minutes by phase (3, 7, 1, 9, 10, 10, 4). That is an agent's estimate, not a human timing; the model above stays the planning figure. The friction it reported was fixed in the lab before this record.

notObserved: No human learner has been timed. The phase minutes above are a model, not an observation.
